newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Explosions destroy houses in Bosnia - NATO.
newsitem.headline: Explosions destroy houses in Bosnia - NATO.

text.p: Six "suspicious" explosions have destroyed four houses in a Bosnian Moslem village, U.S. troops reported on Friday.

A Moslem man in the village of Omerbegovaca suffered a minor head wound from the blasts late on Thurday and was treated at a nearby camp run by the NATO-led peace force, said a statement issued by American troops based in the northeastern town of Tuzla.
The explosions were heard between 11:10 p.m. and 11:20 p.m., the statement said.
NATO sent in troops to investigate the explosions which occurred south of the strategic town of Brcko near former front lines.
Tensions have been running high around Brcko where Serbs have been accused of systematically blowing up houses to discourage Moslems from moving back to their homes.
A peace agreement ended fighting in Bosnia a year ago but nationalist authorities, keen on preserving the country's wartime division, have prevented refugees from returning to their pre-war homes.
